cases.disposition_reason: Holla --scenario parity-task-input opens the finder at 120×40 in truecolor with reduced motion and history off. The world is /srv/app on devbox, production. Pasting Deploy the release selects that row. The preview shows ./deploy.sh and wraps the description as asks for a password and then for confirmation. Enter runs the activity. The output shows $ ./deploy.sh, connecting to release server…, and Password:. i sets Typing goes to the program and typing goes to stdin · Esc returns. Esc leaves input mode (Keyboard returned to holla and Back to Here; Release keyboard is gone). s stops the activity (terminated (SIGTERM) · process group reaped). Esc returns to the finder hint Type Search on the Deploy the release row. Password: and h03-secret are absent. The activity is stopped before Ctrl+Q, so the quit dialog does not open. Ctrl+Q exits 0.
cases.entry_path: launch holla --scenario parity-task-input --color truecolor --motion reduced at 120x40; paste Deploy the release; Enter
cases.return_path: Esc returns to the finder on the deploy row after the activity stops; Ctrl+Q exits

cases.disposition_reason: No baseline file is accepted because a quiet frame of the open secret prompt does not exist, and a spinner frame must not be stored. The prompt is a live Running activity, so animating in src/bin/holla/app.rs is true and on_tick returns Changed; tick there is world.now_ms()/80. SimClock::advance in src/clock.rs adds TICK_MS from src/bin/holla/sim/world.rs only while running, and reduced motion leaves the clock running, so the tab and running-chip spinner change every 80ms. tests/functional/support.rs settle requires 150ms of visual quiet, which never happens. Paused motion freezes now_ms, but World::tick returns before self.tick += 1 when the clock is not running, so elapsed time never reaches the password prompt at at: 3 (prompt(3, "Password: ", true) in src/bin/holla/domain/parity.rs; src/bin/holla/domain/scripts.rs is the other script catalog and does not define this line). The semantic check types h03-secret while Password: is open: the body stays Password: and h03-secret is absent at 120×40, then at 80×24, then again after the restore to 120×40. Enter submits the secret. The public prompt Proceed with rollout? [y/N] shows the answer nope, and h03-secret stays absent. nope is not y, so the script ends with rollout cancelled by operator. On finished Quick no-op, plain i reports The program has finished · nothing reads input and zztyped is not an output line. InputError::NotStarted (Queued · it has no stdin until it starts) and InputError::NoStdin (No stdin · a detached monitor takes no input) are the other refusal strings in activity.rs; this fixture has no queued activity and no detached monitor. On Run the stubborn worker, while Release keyboard is showing, Ctrl+C emits ^C and Sent ^C · stopping · SIGKILL follows if it lingers. Esc then returns the keyboard, and a later z is not appended to the program output.
cases.action_sequence: Answer a public prompt and a secret prompt. Try input when it is refused. Press Ctrl+C and then Escape.
cases.expected_results: The secret is masked. Escape returns keys to the shell. Refused input does not appear as a delivered line.
